heading: Blueprint First. Code Second.
why: We don't guess or write speculative code. Every engagement follows a strict discovery and structural pipeline before development starts.

steps.title: Blueprinting & Scoping
steps.text: Defining functional requirements, user flows, data schemas, and technical specs up front.

steps.title: Wireframing & UI Architecture
steps.text: Structuring site layouts, content hierarchy, and visual design systems in high fidelity.

steps.title: Engineering & CMS Integration
steps.text: Building clean, component-based codebases paired with intuitive editing workflows.

steps.title: Audit, Security & Launch
steps.text: Rigorous testing across browser compatibility, accessibility standards, speed benchmarks, and security checks.
